senses.gloss:
वृध्(उ)वृधु r. 1st cl. (वर्द्धते)
 1. To increase or grow.
 2. The continue,
to last.
 3. To become joyful, to have cause for congratulation.
r. 10th cl. (वर्द्धयति-ते)
 1. To shine.
 2. To speak.

वृधसान m. (-नः) A man.
 E. वृध् to grow, &c. aff. असानच् ।
वृध्न m. (-ध्नः) Bubo in the groin.

वृध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) To be increased or augmented.
 E. वृध् to grow, aff. क्यप् ।
